curve_speed_limit — DRIVE lateral op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.curve_speed_limit(radius, *, side_friction: 'float', superelevation: 'float' = 0.0, g: 'float' = 9.81) (to call the implementation directly, import drivelateral; drivelateral.curve_speed_limit(radius, *, side_friction: 'float', superelevation: 'float' = 0.0, g: 'float' = 9.81); from the registry, opsdrive.get("curve_speed_limit"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Upper speed limit without sliding outward on a curve (radius R) with superelevation i and side-friction coefficient f: v = √(g R (i + f)/(1 − i f)) [m/s].

The exact form obtained by solving for v the commentary's eq. (2) of the Road Structure Ordinance (Japan), Z cos α − G sin α ≤ f (Z sin α + G cos α) (Z = G v²/(gR), i = tan α). If i f ≥ 1 (it does not slide outward at any speed), inf. radius may be an array (> 0).

Raises ValueError: R ≤ 0, f < 0, |i| ≥ 1, i + f ≤ 0 (slides inward even when stopped).

Empty input (radius with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
